clips.title: The story
paras: Rear Guard Patrol is a military scouting mission tasked by Deathguard Linnea to protect the Forsaken defenses along Tirisfal's eastern border. It directs operatives to purge stray Scourge horrors and lingering spirits haunting the Balnir Farmstead before they can compromise the supply lines supporting the Bulwark.

The Bulwark stands as the primary bulwark holding back the pestilence and armies of the Western Plaguelands from spilling into Tirisfal Glades. Deathguard Linnea oversees rear-echelon security along this frontier. Because the line cannot afford to divide its forces against ambushes from behind, any undead that bypass the choke point must be destroyed before they can sever the supply lines feeding the front.

Once a working farm of eastern Tirisfal, the Balnir Farmstead fell to ruin during the Third War. Now thoroughly blighted, the overgrown fields and crumbling stables provide cover for interloping Bleeding Horrors and restless, Wandering Spirits. Clearing the site denies the Lich King a staging post inside Tirisfal itself and safeguards the road for Horde reinforcements.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the Plaguelands are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.
Our success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.
Assist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have a report of your patrol?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good. Your efforts do much to keep the Scourge at bay. A commendation will be sent to my superior, Executor Zygand.
